config-help-simple-BotBehaviour:
Controls how the bot behaves. You can combine several options.

OptionWhat it does
NoneNormal behavior, no extra changes.
Reject invalid friend invitesRejects suspicious friend requests instead of ignoring them.
Reject invalid tradesRejects suspicious trade offers instead of ignoring them.
Reject invalid group invitesRejects suspicious group invites instead of ignoring them.
Dismiss inventory notificationsClears inventory notifications automatically.
Mark received messages as readMarks incoming messages as read.
Mark bot messages as readMarks messages between your ASF bots as read.
Do not parse incoming tradesDoes not automatically review trades you receive.
AllTurns on every option above.

config-help-simple-OnlineStatus:
How friends see you on Steam while the bot is connected.

StatusWhat it does
OnlineYou appear connected as usual.
AwayYou appear away.
InvisibleYou look offline, but the bot stays active.
OfflineYou look offline. Useful to hide farming.
config-help-simple-PasswordFormat:
How the bot password is stored in the config.

OptionWhat it does
Plain textStored as-is. Easier to use, less secure.
AESStored encrypted with AES.
FileRead from an external file.
Environment variableTaken from a system environment variable.
Protected data for current userUses system encryption (e.g. Windows). Safer on that machine.
config-help-simple-RedeemingPreferences:

OptionWhat it does

config-help-simple-SendTradePeriod: How often (in minutes) the bot tries to send pending trades. 0 = disabled.

config-help-simple-SteamTradeToken: Steam trade token so others can send you trades without being friends. Found in your trade offer URL.
config-help-simple-SteamUserPermissions:
Who can control this bot and at what permission level. Pick a bot (or type a Steam ID) and a role, then press Add.

RoleWhat they can do
NoneNo permissions on the bot.
Family SharingBasic Family Sharing access.
OperatorCan use normal bot commands.
MasterBroad control of the bot (recommended for you).
OwnerHighest control, almost like the ASF owner.
config-help-simple-TradeCheckPeriod: How often (in seconds) the bot checks for new trades. A typical value is 60.
config-help-simple-TradingPreferences:
How the bot handles trades. You can combine options.

OptionWhat it does
NoneNo extra preferences.
Steam Trade MatcherWorks with STM-style matching.
Match everythingAllows matching more item types.
Match activelyActively looks for and starts matches.
Don't accept bot tradesIgnores trades from other bots.
Accept donationsAccepts trades where you only receive items.
